description:
Image consultant Jess Han, a troublemaker in Hollywood who specializes in saving irredeemable losers. Jess, who has lived his 30 years with nothing but pride, passion, and competitive spirit, has a new request from the hotel industry king Luke Leonard, who is suffering from scandal. It was okay that he decided to take on his work at the request of his close friend Alan. This man is surprisingly a formidable opponent. Jess, who has lived his whole life with his wits, is also dragged around by Luke, who has a dirty personality, unlike his known image. As he runs, flies, hangs upside down, gets a nosebleed, and eventually falls from the second floor while dreaming of revenge, Luke and he fight like a war every day, but at some point, a strange atmosphere begins to flow, and when he comes to his senses, they are kissing, and when he comes to his senses, (Luke) is saying that they are dating...

*“Sorry to ask, but… Do you know who my lover is?”*

For a moment, he is shocked by the love affair that began without him knowing, but he suddenly enters full-blown love mode, but at that moment, the whole story of the tragedy that happened to the Leonard family is revealed... 

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)
